task: One-year-ahead ranking of Tambon flood-proneness (label: flooded share of area > 5%)

inputs.logit_hist: logit of the smoothed share of earlier years in which the Tambon was flooded
inputs.y_lag1: 1 if the Tambon was flooded in the previous year, else 0

disclaimer: Ranking of long-run flood-proneness for the target year. It is NOT a forecast of how many Tambons will flood or of a specific flood event: the national year-to-year flood level is not predictable from history.
known_limitations: Skill over climatology is small and within year-to-year noise.
Scores are approximate probabilities; use them to rank.
Flood labels come from an annual satellite-derived product (AIT-GIC).
